title: finding(plugin-tree): ObjectTree swaps its rows for a Loading placeholder on every re-read, losing scroll and flashing — keep rows with a refresh indicator, as ObjectDataTable does
body:
Filing-gate category: ② a UX defect with a named site. Reader: triage first (route and grade).

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the contract review of PR objectui#10809 (objectui#10778), which recommends this follow-up; the dev report `5857782762` observed it too.

## The site

`packages/plugin-tree/src/ObjectTree.tsx`'s fetch effect calls `setLoading(true)` on every refetch. The render swaps the table for the "Loading…" placeholder while the read is in flight. Component state survives, but the DOM and the scroll position do not.

## Why it matters more now

- PR objectui#10809 makes the tree re-read on every data-invalidation event for its object. The console's `useMutationInvalidationBridge` puts every data source write on the bus.
- A `list-view` tree now reads twice per event (its own nonce, then ListView's fresh rows), so it can flash twice.
- Once PR objectui#10777 (objectui#10519) removes `PageView`'s remount, a page action on a page holding a tree flashes "Loading…" in place, where today it fully remounts.

## Direction (for triage to confirm)

- Keep the current rows during a re-read, and show a `RefreshIndicator` over them. `ObjectDataTable` already does this (`@object-ui/components`' `RefreshIndicator`). Show the placeholder only on the first load.
- Pin: after a bus event the rows stay in the DOM while the read is pending, and the indicator shows. A first mount shows the placeholder (control).
